 "nieve": "Keep the exact same camera angle, framing and composition, and the same buildings, objects and landmarks in the same positions and with the same shapes. Everything else stays exactly as it is. Change only what the scene below asks for: heavy winter snowfall, thick fresh snow covering every roof, ledge, tree and the ground, snowflakes in the air, cold soft white daylight. A few people leave footprints in the snow.",
 "fuego": "Keep the exact same camera angle, framing and composition, and the same buildings, objects and landmarks in the same positions and with the same shapes. Everything else stays exactly as it is. Change only what the scene below asks for: the buildings are on fire, bright orange flames coming out of windows, roofs and trees, the objects in the sky stay intact, thick black smoke rising into a dark orange sky, firelight reflecting on every surface. Completely empty of people.",
 "abandonada": "Keep the exact same camera angle, framing and composition, and the same buildings, objects and landmarks in the same positions and with the same shapes. Everything else stays exactly as it is. Change only what the scene below asks for: abandoned for decades, cracked dirty surfaces, broken dark windows, weeds, overgrown grass and vines growing everywhere, dusty muted daylight. Completely empty of people. The vehicles already on the street stay exactly where they are and keep exactly their size and perspective, now old, rusty and covered in dust and leaves. No new vehicles are added.",
 "inundada": "Keep the exact same camera angle, framing and composition, and the same buildings, objects and landmarks in the same positions and with the same shapes. Everything else stays exactly as it is. Change only what the scene below asks for: flood, calm brown water covering all the ground up to the first floors, reflections of the buildings and trees on the water, flat diffuse overcast light under a uniform gray sky, soft shadowless light on every building. No people and no cars; only one single small motorboat floats alone on the water, well apart from everything else.",
 "cyberpunk": "Keep the exact same camera angle, framing and composition, and the same buildings, objects and landmarks in the same positions and with the same shapes. Everything else stays exactly as it is. Change only what the scene below asks for: the same place in the year 2080 at night, a photorealistic cyberpunk megacity like a real night photograph: the buildings in front keep their shapes but get big vertical neon signs with Japanese characters on their corners and side walls, glowing magenta, cyan and electric blue; behind them, gigantic futuristic megatowers rise into the sky with thousands of lit windows and glowing lights; several flying cars with headlights travel between the towers; neon-colored haze, glossy street reflecting all the neon. Everything in the sky keeps its own colors and stays clearly visible.",
 "golden hour": "Keep the people, faces, objects, composition, framing, materials and colors exactly as they are. Change only the lighting: warm low golden-hour sunlight from the left, long soft shadows, warm rim light on edges.",
 "futurista": "Keep the exact same camera angle, framing and composition, and the same buildings, objects and landmarks in the same positions and with the same shapes. Everything else stays exactly as it is. Change only what the scene below asks for: the same place in a clean bright future, by day: the same buildings and landmarks keep their exact shapes but get sleek white and glass futuristic panels, smooth curved facades and green terraces, the old corner building looks fully modern with no hard straight lines, its clock tower dome becomes a high-tech structure, never remove any structure, no cars on the roads, flying vehicles hovering above the avenue and in the sky, people in futuristic clothing walking, every person at a realistic size consistent with their distance from the camera.",
 "anime": "Convert this entire photo into a 2D hand-drawn anime illustration. Keep the same composition, framing and layout, and keep every logo and lettering exactly as it is, painted directly on the surface it is on, with no frame, box, border or sign panel around it. Japanese anime film background art in the style of Makoto Shinkai: everything redrawn with clean ink outlines and flat cel-shaded colors, painted buildings with simplified anime detail, people and cars drawn as simple anime characters and vehicles, luminous painted sky with big stylized clouds and lens flare, saturated warm sunset palette. Clearly a drawing, not a photograph.",
 "destrucción": "Keep the exact same camera angle, framing and composition, and the same buildings, objects and landmarks in the same positions and with the same shapes. Everything else stays exactly as it is. Change only what the scene below asks for: post-apocalyptic destruction of the whole city, photorealistic: every building near and far is burnt and damaged, with dark soot stains, holes blasted into the facades, chunks of wall missing and many shattered black windows; low rubble and debris scattered across the ground; thick gray smoke haze and fog filling the street and swallowing the distant towers; dramatic gloomy gray light. Completely empty of people. The vehicles already on the street stay exactly where they are and keep exactly their size and perspective, now burnt wrecks. No new vehicles are added.",
 "noche": "Keep the people, faces, objects, composition, framing, materials and colors exactly as they are. Change only the lighting: a realistic night: dark blue night sky, glowing shop windows and street lamps, warm lit windows in the buildings, the avenue keeps only the few cars already in the photo, with no new cars added. There is no sunlight anywhere: everything high up in the sky catches only a soft, natural, diffuse glow from the city below, just enough to separate it from the dark blue sky, with no bright rim of light. The far end of the avenue is quiet and dark. Photorealistic, like a real night photograph taken with a fast shutter: no light trails and no long-exposure streaks anywhere."
}
